CONTRACT INTELLIGENCE

# Contracts are everyone's business.

Accelerate legal work and unlock the value of contracts across the enterprise. Luminance is the single source of contract intelligence delivered to everyone, everywhere, to mitigate risk and capture commercial opportunity.

[REQUEST A DEMO](https://www.luminance.com/#get-started)

TRUSTED BY 1,000+ ENTERPRISES WORLDWIDE

Our Platform

## Turn every contract into intelligence you can act on.

Every contract contains knowledge about how your business operates, from accepted positions to risk and obligations. Luminance makes that knowledge visible and actionable across Legal, Procurement, Finance and every team in the enterprise.

[**Discover**\\
\\
Skip the search. Turn your contract portfolio into actionable insights, surfacing risk, obligations, and commercial opportunities in seconds.\\
\\
![Luminance repository dashboard surfacing key contract terms and risk insights](https://framerusercontent.com/images/83pIDLP9pkWNazeVsFpnKP1fuD4.png?width=2880&height=1576)](https://www.luminance.com/platform/product/repository)

[**Negotiate**\\
\\
Bring precedent and playbooks into every negotiation. Review faster, negotiate stronger, and protect the terms that matter. \\
\\
![Luminance negotiation workspace showing contract redlines and playbook-driven suggestions](https://framerusercontent.com/images/bb5TAk9h8szWvjih7nBWkXCfDGw.png?width=2880&height=1576)](https://www.luminance.com/platform/product/negotiation)

[**Automate**\\
\\
Keep contracts moving through connected workflows that bring every stakeholder, system, and action into one process from intake to signature.\\
\\
![Luminance workflow view showing a contract moving through intake, review and signature](https://framerusercontent.com/images/q4wyzrR2bPcSR82Lh3Tt6o2LOY.png?width=2880&height=1576)](https://www.luminance.com/platform/product/workflows)

our vision

## We believe in a world where contracts learn from the enterprise, and enterprises learn from their contracts.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/TFaBrQ3lrKQps5q689UA6E6tM4.webp?width=2749&height=3889)

Every contract, negotiation, and decision adds to what your business already knows. Luminance carries that knowledge across the enterprise, helping teams act with greater context and confidence.

Founded by researchers from the University of Cambridge, Luminance has pioneered Contract Intelligence for over a decade.

**Always learning**

Every contract strengthens your institutional intelligence.

**Always circulating**

The right contractual context reaches every team that needs it.

**Always moving**

Insight becomes action, keeping contracts progressing, decisions moving and the enterprise in motion.

[Learn more](https://www.luminance.com/company/about)

OUR TECHNOLOGY ARCHITECTURE

## Built to understand the complexity of enterprise contracts.

Luminance combines specialist legal models with deep contractual context to understand contracts in context not just as text.

[See what makes Luminance different](https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology)

Trust at every layer

## Security engineered for the enterprise

ISO 27001

Luminance maintains an independently certified Information Security Management System covering the development, operation, sales, and support of its technology platform.

SOC 2 TYPE II

Luminance undergoes regular SOC 2 Type II examinations to provide ongoing independent assurance over controls related to security, availability, and confidentiality.

Independent Penetration Testing

Independent third parties regularly test the Luminance application and operational systems against evolving threats. Further information is available through the security review process.

[Learn more](https://trust.luminance.com/)
